findings.detail: The selected generic corotational B2/B3 route averages principal nodal axial rotation Logs. In pi units let d=1/10000. Initial twists [-d,d] (B2) or [-2d,d,d] (B3) have zero mean. A common pi rotation gives principal means 0 and -1/3*pi rather than pi, while physical relative twists remain at most 3*d*pi below 0.9*pi. Total-coordinate re-expression cannot change the internally recomputed Log(Exp(theta)); the frozen unchanged route therefore cannot provide the required unrestricted common-rotation covariance.
